item.tib: lung na med pa'i lha mo gre ma lnga / las kyi dbang gis bod kyi yul du dar / legs bshad gzungs kyi snying po 'di kho na
item.note: according to this final colophon, it was revealed by spa-ston rgyal-ba shes-rab bzang-po (also known as spa rgyal-ba shes-rab, known to be a personal disciple of dbyil-ston, as it seems also in our colophon). two persons requested it from him, spa-ston don-grub 'bum and nyi-dpal bzang-po.
